dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000phrk](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000phrk) Magnitude 5.8 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Jan 04 2025 24km E of Dulecha. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 9.5045 longitude 40.169. It impacted 226735 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
